metadata.title: European Basketball Coaches from Wikipedia
metadata.scope: Country-by-team English Wikipedia categories associated with European domestic, regional and continental basketball leagues.
metadata.ratingExplanation: Head-coach honors receive full competition-specific value. Assistant, consultant and youth honors receive reduced value. Player achievements remain in the database but receive zero coaching points. Experience is added and raw scores are percentile-ranked across the scraped European pool. The 99th percentile and above is capped at 90.

coaches.name: Andrzej Urban
sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Poland by team

biography.introduction: Andrzej Urban (born November 9, 1991) is a Polish professional basketball coach. He is the current head coach of BM Stal Ostrów Wielkopolski of the Polish Basketball League.

orderedInfoboxRows.value: As head coach Polish Basketball Supercup champion (2022) European North Basketball League champion (2023) As assistant coach: Polish Basketball League champion (2021) 2× Polish Basketball Cup winner (2019, 2022)
orderedInfoboxRows.html:
As head coach
  • Polish Basketball Supercup champion (2022)
  • European North Basketball League champion (2023)

As assistant coach:

  • Polish Basketball League champion (2021)
  • 2× Polish Basketball Cup winner (2019, 2022)

biography.introduction: Sven Ušić (born 19 August 1959) is a former Croatian professional basketball player and coach. At a height of 2.01 m (6 ft 7 in) tall, he played as a small forward.

  • 2× EuroLeague champion (1985, 1986)
  • 2× FIBA Saporta Cup champion (1982, 1987)

coaches.name: Žarko Đurišić

biography.introduction: Žarko Đurišić (Serbian Cyrillic: Жарко Ђуришић; born March 31, 1961), also credited as Zarko Durisic, is a Montenegrin-born Slovenian basketball scout, former player, and former coach who is currently the Director of international player personnel for the Minnesota Timberwolves of the National Basketball Association (NBA).
